vendor_source.relation_to_github_snapshot_in_camera_au: The local vendor-tree vga_modes.h and display_ctrl.c SHA-256 values differ from those recorded for the separately pinned GitHub snapshot in report/stage3_camera_reference_audit_20261007.json. This audit therefore identifies and analyzes the local vendor-tree files by their hashes and does not claim they are the same source revision.

algorithm.assumption_note: dynclk.c says this implementation currently requires a 100 MHz reference clock; the source marks configurable/read-from-hardware support as TODO.
algorithm.search: For DIVCLK_DIVIDE 1..10, feedback multiplier from 6*D through min(12*D,64), calculate the rounded output divider and choose the smallest frequency error.

independent_algorithm_reproduction.reproduction_method: A read-only PowerShell loop reproduced the integer search and rounding equations visible in dynclk.c:184-205, then applied the source's final divide-by-five at lines 216-217.
independent_algorithm_reproduction.qualification: This is a calculation of the source algorithm under its 100 MHz reference assumption, not evidence that software ran or that these clocks exist on the current PL design.

runtime_path_in_source.description: display_ctrl.c calls ClkFindParams and ClkFindReg, then ClkStart for the selected display mode. Static source flow only.
